'''Tau Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]s serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They fought rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|coup]] [[Zaarin's fleet|forces]] during an [[Zaarin insurrection|insurrection]].
